purpose: Reproducible correctness and throughput testing for offline observation batches; not a claim of production capacity.

generator.source_cases: Cycle through the five committed synthetic fixture records in stable order. For generated unique records, rewrite observation_id and source_event_id with deterministic sequence IDs; vary result values, timestamps, and payload digests from the seeded state. Recompute mapped payload digests for transformation-bearing records using the declared digest profile.
generator.prohibition: Generated records must never be relabelled as field, sensor, lab, or community evidence.

duplicate_profiles.expected_behavior: deduplicate exact copies and report them
deduplicate exact copies and report them
one unique record if all copies are identical
reject entire batch when same ID carries different content

negative_controls: unknown fields at root and nested record
same observation ID with mutated result
phenomenon window ending after result time
non-current calibration on accepted sensor record
local frame missing its unit declaration
raw-public-approved release without valid consent reference
synthetic fixture relabelled as real observation
measures: input bytes and normalized output bytes
incorrect acceptance rate for negative controls
incorrect rejection rate for valid controls
process exit status and typed error category
caveats: All thresholds are proposed; freeze the reference machine and run harness before turning them into release gates.
The current validator checks digest syntax and transformation-chain continuity but does not hash raw source bytes itself; adapter callers must provide the digest of retained/exact bytes.
The throughput workload generator and benchmark executable are follow-up work, not contained in this manifest.
Performance on synthetic homogeneous records does not establish throughput for remote-sensing raster datasets or causal/physical model validation.
